notes:
Summary: Copper Fern is a mid-enterprise CX platform (ticketing + knowledge base + AI agent) evaluating Redwood to replace in-house retrieval pipeline. Core goal is ticket deflection + short-resolution assistant. They have ~6M customer-facing KB docs, 200M total historical tickets to consider for cold indexing.

Timeline (bulleted):
- 2025-11-12: Lead sourced via webinar; initial qualification (Aisha). high-volume support customers, strong EU footprint.
- 2025-12-03: Discovery call w/ engineering + head of CX (ff-20251203-5541). noted target deflection 30-40% within 6 months.
- 2026-01-15: Demo focused on embeddings + rerank workflow (ff-20260115-8876). technical team asked about rerank hybrid (approximate ANN + cross-encoder).
- 2026-02-18: Deep-dive with infra + security (ff-20260218-9812). shared security FAQ, asked about VPC/private control plane.
- 2026-03-05: Provided POC plan and sample dataset spec. agreed to run indexing test of 6M docs and 1k qps stress.
- 2026-03-08: Eng sync — confirmed readiness to start dedicated POC cluster once legal/residency is cleared.

Use-case + requirements (shorthand):
- Primary workload: conversational support agent + RAG for ticket deflection. live queries must be low-latency; most queries are short conversational + follow-ups.
- Index scale: initial index ~6M docs, plan to expand to ~50M with cold-tier. retention of historic tickets for long-tail retrieval.
- Latency SLOs: p95 end-to-end for top-5 rerank <= 200-250ms; P50 target ~30-60ms for ANN candidate gen only. reranker allowed slightly higher but must still hit p95 budget.
- Throughput: steady-state 300-600 qps, peak planned 1k qps during campaigns.
- Cost sensitivity: enterprise budget-conscious; target < $0.02 per query (vector search + rerank amortized) but willing to pay for SLA.
- Reranking workflow desired: ANN candidate generation (top-50) -> cross-encoder re-rank to top-5. want Redwood to support both efficient kv+ANN and orchestrated re-rank step with model variants.
- Models: prefer open/quantized models for rerank; exploring 3rd-party cross-encoders and Redwood-verified variants.
- Caching: session-level prefix/KV caching required for repeat interactions to reduce token cost.
- Deployment: prefer Dedicated in VPC for predictable throughput; fall back to Hosted for burst capacity.

Security / compliance notes:
- Must support SSO (SAML/SCIM), KMS integration, audit logs retained 2 years for compliance team.
- Data residency: primary EU tenant data needs to remain in eu-west region for a subset of customers.
- Legal: awaiting DPA + security annex sign-off (blocker).

Technical concerns raised by engineering:
- How Redwood schedules cross-encoder reranks under tight latency. want details on kernel selection + batching guarantees.
- Memory footprint for 6M dense vectors on Dedicated nodes; asked about hybrid disk/embedding tiering and cold storage for long-tail.
- Query-cost modeling: need per-query cost breakdown (ANN + re-rank + model tokens) at 1k qps.

Quotes / paraphrases from calls:
- "We need the agent to return a top-5 that our UI can surface within 200ms — otherwise conversions drop." — Head of CX.
- "If reranking doubles latency we're not comfortable unless it's strictly controlled by SLO-based routing." — Lead Infra Eng.

POC plan (high level):
- Phase 1: Small-prod index (6M docs) + ANN config exploration (Faiss/HNSW) — measure p50/p95 candidate gen.
- Phase 2: Rerank integration with a candidate set -> cross-encoder on Dedicated sizing. AB test deflection rate vs baseline.
- Phase 3: Scale plans, residency partitioning, fallback to Hosted for burst.

Next steps (explicit):
- Redwood SE (Connor) to provide sizing and cost estimate for Dedicated cluster (action: by 2026-03-14).
- Legal to receive DPA + security annex from Redwood (action: legal follow-up).
- Start POC data transfer and index dry-run (action: Copper Fern infra; target kickoff 2026-03-20).

Open questions / blockers (short):
- exact p95 budget allocation between ANN and rerank?
- ability to pin cross-encoder model variants per-tenant?
- eviction policy for cold vectors and cost tradeoffs?
